children.title: Cycle 143 · Investigating Divergent Values through Controlled Comparative Simulation

detail.title: Investigating Divergent Values through Controlled Comparative Simulation
detail.summary: This cycle evaluates the previous inconclusive experiment on value divergence. We identify the lack of a single-agent control as the primary limitation. We are now revising the hypothesis to explicitly define the divergence comparison between isolated and coupled systems, and preparing a new experiment to implement this control group.
